mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contract_reminder_event (contract_id, due_date, reminder_stage, status) VALUES (#{contractId}, #{dueDate}, #{stage}, 'PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.contract_id, e.due_date, e.reminder_stage, e.status, e.created_at, e.acked_at FROM contract_reminder_event e WHERE e.id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT e.id, CONCAT('合同到期提醒（', e.reminder_stage, '） · ', emp.name) AS title, e.id AS resource_id, c.employee_id AS employee_id, e.status, e.reminder_stage, e.due_date AS due_at, e.created_at FROM contract_reminder_event e JOIN employee_contract c ON c.id = e.contract_id JOIN employee emp ON emp.id = c.employee_id WHERE e.status = 'PENDING' AND c.renewal_status = 'NOT_DUE' AND ( 1 = 1 emp.department_id = #{departmentId} 1 = 0 ) ORDER BY e.due_date ASC, e.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
